name: Leather
desc: A hide at follicle scale that will not stop working — pebble grain domed between its creases, a bend wave travelling through so the crease network bites shut and opens again, dye pooled dark in the valleys and rubbed off the crowns, and the abraded high points showing the pale corium underneath.

wear.doc: 0 = pristine hide · 1.4 = destroyed — crowns rubbed through to the pale corium, burnish gone dark

scale.doc: how close the macro plate sits — fine calf grain through to coarse pebbled bull

energy.doc: how hard the burnished crowns glint under the raking light

density.doc: follicle count, crease depth and how tightly the grain is packed

hue.doc: re-dyes the hide (24 = true tan/chestnut; ~5 reads oxblood)

speed.doc: rate of the bend wave working through the hide, and of the light

style.doc: full_grain: natural veg-tan aniline, dye deep in the creases, crowns coming up burnished · distressed: hard-worn two-tone pull-up, corium showing through everywhere · patent: mirror-lacquered, the grain drowned under gloss · suede: napped flesh side — matte, fibrous, scattering instead of glinting · cast: non-representational — a plaster cast of the grain, form from light only, no colour or dye at all

act.doc: flex: the bend wave travels and the grain works · age: the patina deepens and pulls back across sections · stretch: the hide is pulled taut and eased, the grain opening and closing

seed.doc: a different hide — new follicle lattice, wrinkle network and wear map
